description: Building Height Limits is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Housing and Urban Development. IMPORTANT NOTE: This dataset is based on the Development Act 1993 zones and is now superseded by the Building Height datasets (found in [Planning and Design Code Variations][id]) under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Housing and Urban Development. Its tags are building, building heights, urban planning. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, html, kml, map viewer, shp. The portal shows 2024-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
